goal: Make the post-payment thank-you plus other-destinations whisper fail-safe when the trusted payment ledger records gold but the primary post-payment sender produces no confirmed outgoing whisper.
notes: Lua-only reliability guard. Keep the existing trusted wallet-delta ledger and primary retry logic unchanged. Track actual paymentLog row identities, arm a 2.2 s grace window for each newly appended row, suppress the guard when CHAT_MSG_WHISPER_INFORM confirms the primary Hyjal/Hydraxis/Winterspring offer to that payer, otherwise send exactly one bounded fallback. The guard obeys the existing postPaymentOfferEnabled toggle and never replays ledger rows that existed when it initialized.
